name: uniflow
description: A small timetable and planning app I made for university life.

scripts.start:mac: npm run prepare:version && npm run prepare:ocr && electron .
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:version && npm run prepare:ocr && npm run prepare:icon && node scripts/package-mac.cjs && node scripts/prune-mac-build.mjs
scripts.build:mac:mas: npm run prepare:version && npm run prepare:ocr && npm run prepare:icon && node scripts/package-mac-mas.cjs && node scripts/prune-mac-build.mjs
scripts.sync:ios: npm run prepare:version && npm run prepare:ocr && npx cap sync ios
scripts.check: node scripts/sync-version.mjs --check && node --check dist/app.js && node --check dist/schedule.js && node --check dist/history.js && node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check scripts/package-mac.cjs && node --check scripts/package-mac-mas.cjs && node --check scripts/prune-mac-build.mjs && npm test
